description: Source code implementing a client-side SRP (Secure Remote Password) authentication protocol, including functions for initializing a client, generating cryptographic keys, computing passwords, and verifying responses.

methods.name: t_clientopen
methods.description: Initializes a new SRP client session with user credentials and parameters, performing validation and cryptographic setup.

methods.name: t_clientgenexp
methods.description: Generates a public ephemeral value (A) for the SRP protocol based on a random private exponent.

methods.name: t_clientpasswd
methods.description: Computes the verifier (v) from the password, salt, and other parameters for registration or authentication.

methods.name: t_clientgetkey
methods.description: Calculates the session key based on server's public value and client parameters, completing the SRP handshake.

methods.name: t_clientverify
methods.description: Verifies the server's response by comparing the expected hash with the received response.

methods.name: t_clientresponse
methods.description: Returns the computed session response hash for authentication.

methods.name: t_clientclose
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with the client session.
